sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:98

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:98:1
items.html: HBD, which are the fathers that are in ZA, etc., relative to AVI they are HGT, and they are literally the fathers. Meaning, that although the Mochin come from the upper AVI who rose to the GAR of AA, as above, nevertheless ZA does not receive them from the GAR, who are the upper AVI, but from their HGT; and therefore they are HGT relative to AVI. And what he writes, “and understand this,” comes to hint that for this reason the Hochma is not received except by way of the Yesodot of AVI, and all the revelation of the Hochma is in the measure of the Yesod, which are narrow ways. For even at the ascent of ZA to AA, he does not rise there to the Mazal Notzer, which is the discernment of the upper AVI, where the Tifferet is revealed in its being in its own right, but only to the Mazal VeNakeh, which is the discernment of YESHSUT, which does not receive except in the measure of the Yesodot, as above at length. See there.
